title: GIMS Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 100 Staff Nurse Posts
description: The Government Institute of Medical Sciences (GIMS) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies for 100 Staff Nurse Jobs. Interested and eligible aspirants can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their B.Sc Nursing or GNM can apply for the GIMS Notification 2026. Interested applicants can apply in offline mode. Here we have mentioned the education details, age limit, selection process, application ...
